content.name: Construct-validity v0 — the canonical construct self-verifying loop (every construct APPLIES_IN it)
content.lineage: The shared canonical model of what a construct IS: a self-verifying loop. Its forward anatomy spine (loop_space GOVERNS objective -> ADDRESSED_BY pattern -> SHAPES behavior -> REFINED_BY algorithm -> DEFINED_BY code -> REALIZED_BY implementation), its runtime firing (implementation -> Sensor -> DepositBond -> trigger atom -> Threshold -> IntentProposal/PhysicsEvent -> ActionIntent -> EffectIntent -> EffectReceipt -> Moment) and its verify arc (implementation OBSERVED_BY observability_algorithm PRODUCES metric FEEDS health) are closed into a LOOP by six feedback edges. Consumed by every construct through APPLIES_IN / DEPENDS_ON; owned by no single toolkit. Promoted from the model first authored in [[space:l2:mind-universe:abstraction-toolkit-v0]]. This v0 REPLACES an earlier invented validity decomposition with the complete, faithful loop anatomy: 34 parts, 42 edges, exactly 6 of them feedback.

parent_scope.justification: A shared canonical contract awaiting installation under the sensemaking/meta registry Space. Exactly one scope classification; conformed to via APPLIES_IN and consumed via DEPENDS_ON, structurally owned by none.

content.native_law_boundary: AtomDynamics knows only AtomSpec, AtomBond and support/inhibit/neutral. This construct adds no law; it is the canonical DEFINITION of the self-verifying loop every construct conforms to. The 34 parts, 42 edges, runtime moments and maintenance affordances are data, not native dispatch.
content.purpose: Give the Universe one shared, canonical definition of what a construct IS — a self-verifying loop — that every construct APPLIES_IN and conforms to. The loop is a forward anatomy spine, a runtime firing and a verify arc, closed by six feedback edges so that nothing self-certifies without a FRESH, independently-observed health_assessment (a stale healthy reading yields 'stale', never 'healthy'). A construct DEPENDS_ON this definition; this construct is itself an instance of the loop it defines.

self_verifying_loop.note: The complete, faithful anatomy of the construct self-verifying loop. Every construct APPLIES_IN this loop and reports its validity as the fresh, independently-observed health this loop derives. 34 parts, 42 edges, 6 of them feedback.

roles.objective: Role 1/12: the observable success_condition / semantic promise; GOVERNED by loop_space, JUSTIFIED_BY justification, and (feedback) SUPPORTED by health.
roles.justification: Role 8/12: whyItSatisfiesObjective plus rejectedAlternatives (the roads not taken); the objective is JUSTIFIED_BY this, and every gate DEPENDS_ON the same evidence.
roles.pattern: Role 2/12: the design rationale / reusable shape (evidence-bearing spine that separates identity, execution, observation, measurement, health, repair); ADDRESSED_BY objective, SHAPES behavior.
roles.vocabulary: Role 3/12: the terms plus forbiddenConflations (running!=healthy, empty!=known_absent, missing_value!=0, rendered!=committed, file_exists!=deployed); USED by behavior.
roles.behavior: Role 4/12: the given/when/then/forbidden observable contract; SHAPED by pattern, USES_VOCABULARY, REFINED_BY algorithm, VALIDATED_BY validation.
roles.algorithm: Role 5/12: the ordered steps refining behavior (resolve roles/relations, run validation, observe, measure, derive health, render failure front, re-observe); DEFINED_BY code.
roles.code: Role 6/12: the graph-native CodeDefinition (causal-expression-ast / health AST / seal atom circuit), no implicit Python; REALIZED_BY implementation, CHALLENGED_BY validation.
roles.validation: Role 9/12: fixtures plus invariants challenging code/behavior; its execution PRODUCES a validation_run runtime moment (never pre-created).
roles.implementation: Role 7/12: the honest realized state with graph-defined/wired/running/verified kept as distinct fields; REALIZED_BY code, OBSERVED_BY the observer. The thing wired into the field, waiting to be fired.
roles.observability_algorithm: Role 10/12: the INDEPENDENT observer; mustNotTrust implementation health claim / renderer success flag / process running state / file presence; OBSERVES implementation via readback, PRODUCES the metric, is itself VERIFIED_BY observer_validation.
roles.observer_validation: The check on the checker: proves the observer detects real faults (broken-visible-edge, missing-proof, stale-evidence, renderer-lies) and never converts missing proof into success; observability_algorithm is VERIFIED_BY / VALIDATED_BY it.
roles.metric: Role 11/12: the metric VECTOR (forbidOpaqueAggregate; per-dimension provenance and evidence_freshness_seconds, no collapsed scalar score); PRODUCED by the observer, FEEDS health.
roles.health: Role 12/12: derived state (healthy/degraded/stale/unknown/not_measured/measurement_failed) from a fresh metric vector; FED by metric, SUPPORTS objective (feedback) and REPAIRED_BY maintenance. No healthy state without a fresh health_assessment.

anatomy.loop_space: The L2 construct spine; roots and GOVERNS the loop and declares reads/writes/forbidden_effects and exactly one parent_scope. A Construct is what a Toolkit produces: the built, self-verifying thing placed in a world (a pen, a house alarm) that proves its own effects.
anatomy.Inputs: What the turn consumes — the WorldObservation prompt: two frames (MindEye L1 + CitizenEye L2) plus context (role, needs and energy, memory, objective, recent receipts).
anatomy.Affordances: The reachable action verbs, each with an exact target, precondition and justification; an unproven target is never offered as a verb.
anatomy.Preconditions: Measured, all_required, non-compensatory conditions gating the Mechanism (missing_binding -> not_measured_and_inert); each gate DEPENDS_ON independently measured/observed evidence.
anatomy.Mechanism: How it works — the fuel-bounded, mutation-free VM plus the inference (one local Ollama call, serial, one in flight; 'the inference is the clock') that assembles the WorldObservation and returns a candidate.
anatomy.Effects: The committed changes it produces at the tick boundary; the construct proves its own effects (a preview/animation is not a commit).
anatomy.Receipts: The durable proof of what it did; only what commits stays authoritative and inspectable — the receipts and the event log.

trigger.Sensor: Construct pattern part 1: a physical condition (e.g. a collider on an entry membrane) placed in the field. Self-wake, never poll.
trigger.DepositBond: Construct pattern part 2: on the physics event, +energy onto a trigger atom — a Support bond, stamped energy_status measured (not authored/derived/unknown).
trigger.trigger atom: The atom a DepositBond deposits +energy onto; accrues supporting energy and fires once support >= N.
trigger.Threshold: Construct pattern part 3: the atom fires at support >= N (e.g. seal_gate threshold 1200 = twelve measured supports x100); the moment-to-act is a threshold the solver reports for free, not a scan.

runtime_moment.wake-queue: The physics step fills it; the single continuous serial loop drains it so each construct takes its turn and dormant constructs cost nothing.
runtime_moment.IntentProposal: The candidate the inference returns: one chosen verb on an exact target with its justification. The model proposes; the world disposes; the inference never touches the store.
runtime_moment.PhysicsEvent: The observed sensor intersection / threshold event; it never mutates the Universe directly.
runtime_moment.ActionIntent: The intent a PhysicsEvent is lifted into (or the IntentProposal that rises to the L3 body and is attempted); validated before any effect.
runtime_moment.EffectIntent: Construct pattern part 4: after validate, the fire emits a SemanticIntent or EffectIntent{notify} routed to an authorized transport.
runtime_moment.EffectReceipt: The result returned by the effect's authorized transport (EffectIntent -> transport -> EffectReceipt), reinjected into the Universe.
runtime_moment.Moment: The committed terminal of the chain: the authoritative, inspectable record (inscription_receipt / CommitReceipt); what re-enters the next turn's context.
runtime_moment.validation_run: Produced by validation execution (runtimeMomentsArePrecreated:false): run_id, loop_id, validation_id, fixture_results, invariant_results, evidence_refs, execution_status.
runtime_moment.health_assessment: Produced by health derivation from a FRESH metric vector (precreated:false): assessment_id, observer_run_ref, metric_samples, derived_state, derived_at, fresh_until, evidence_refs, failure_front.

maintenance.maintenance: The 13th loop member: reversible repair affordances keyed to failing health states; the REPAIRED_BY target whose repairs (retry-observer, restore-built-state) re-enter implementation and close the loop.

self_verifying_loop.why_it_is_a_loop: The forward path is a one-way anatomy SPINE (loop_space GOVERNS objective -> ADDRESSED_BY pattern -> SHAPES behavior -> REFINED_BY algorithm -> DEFINED_BY code -> REALIZED_BY implementation) followed by a runtime firing (implementation wired into the field -> Sensor -> DepositBond -> trigger atom -> Threshold fires -> IntentProposal / PhysicsEvent -> ActionIntent -> validate -> EffectIntent -> EffectReceipt -> Moment) and a verify arc (implementation OBSERVED_BY observability_algorithm PRODUCES metric FEEDS health). By itself that is a CHAIN. It becomes a genuine LOOP through several explicit feedback edges that re-drive the construct, none of which a naive sensor->effect->health pipeline has. (1) health SUPPORTS objective: the derived Health folds back to support the very Objective the loop_space GOVERNS, so the loop cannot self-certify without a FRESH health_assessment (a stale healthy reading yields 'stale', never 'healthy'). (2) health REPAIRED_BY maintenance, and maintenance feeds_back into implementation: retry-observer re-runs the observer against the current build and restore-built-state replays valid construction receipts, re-entering the observe->metric->health arc. (3) Moment feeds_back into Inputs: only what commits stays authoritative, and 'recent receipts' re-enter the WorldObservation context that drives the next inference's IntentProposal. (4) Effects feeds_back into Sensor via the physics-event -> energy-deposit bridge: the effect-world's new physics events re-fire the sensor so the Threshold re-arms and waits again rather than one-shot dead-ending (dormant constructs cost nothing). (5) Effects feeds_back into Threshold: 'mutating any claim invalidates its prior signature and re-opens the seal', so the signatures_valid support de-conducts and the gate can no longer fire until re-sealed. (6) Preconditions DEPENDS_ON justification: each non-compensatory gate re-enters the same independently measured/observed evidence the objective is JUSTIFIED_BY (the gate/evidence diamond). Edges (1) and (6) carry their exact canonical predicates (SUPPORTS, DEPENDS_ON) but are marked feedback:true; edges (2)-(5) are the implicit re-entries carried as the token feeds_back.

content.applies_to: every construct in the Universe, present and future — each conforms to (APPLIES_IN) this one self-verifying loop, and its validity is ALWAYS the fresh, independently-observed health this loop derives. Not a capability toolkit (like sky/mechanical); the canonical loop definition itself. This construct is an instance of the loop it defines. Non-construct kernel entities are out of scope.

terms.self_verifying_loop: The canonical construct: a forward anatomy spine plus a runtime firing plus a verify arc, closed by six feedback edges.
terms.loop_space: The L2 construct spine that roots and GOVERNS the loop; declares reads/writes/forbidden_effects and exactly one parent_scope.
terms.trigger: Sensor -> DepositBond -> trigger atom -> Threshold: a physical condition, a Support bond depositing +energy, the atom accruing it, the fire at support >= N.

content.loop_part: the given/when/then/forbidden observable contract of the loop
content.given: A construct with its forward spine (pattern/behavior/algorithm), its trigger (Sensor/DepositBond/trigger atom/Threshold), its implementation wired into the field, and its verify arc (observer, metric, health).
content.when: The construct is woken from the wake-queue and takes its turn, or an observer inspects the construct's loop.
then: the forward spine resolves in order: loop_space GOVERNS objective, ADDRESSED_BY pattern, SHAPES behavior, REFINED_BY algorithm, DEFINED_BY code, REALIZED_BY implementation
the trigger fires only at support >= N accumulated by measured Support bonds, never on a single unmeasured event
a PhysicsEvent never mutates: it is lifted to an ActionIntent, validated, then an EffectIntent is emitted to an authorized transport
implementation is OBSERVED_BY an independent observer that PRODUCES a metric vector that FEEDS health
the six feedback edges re-drive the loop; no construct is reported healthy without a fresh health_assessment
forbidden: collapsing the metric vector into one opaque scalar
letting the implementation self-report its own health
treating a PhysicsEvent as a semantic mutation
offering an unproven target as an affordance verb

steps: resolve the construct's roles and relations (the forward spine)
run validation, which PRODUCES a validation_run (never pre-created)
wait to be woken from the wake-queue on a physics event; never poll
observe implementation independently by readback (not self-report)
measure: PRODUCE the metric vector with per-dimension provenance and freshness
derive health from the FRESH metric vector and render the failure front
re-observe: fold Moment back into Inputs and Effects back onto Sensor/Threshold so the loop re-arms

This describes the loop faithfully; it does not yet execute it.

content.loop_part: whyItSatisfiesObjective plus rejectedAlternatives; the objective is JUSTIFIED_BY this, and every gate DEPENDS_ON the same evidence
why: A one-way sensor->effect->health pipeline ENDS at health and can never re-drive itself; the six feedback edges are exactly what turn the anatomy spine into a genuine loop.

An INDEPENDENT observer that mustNotTrust the implementation's health claim, the renderer's success flag, the process running-state or file presence keeps 'running != healthy' and 'rendered != committed' honest.
Runtime moments (validation_run, health_assessment) are PRODUCED by execution and never pre-created, so no construct self-certifies from a seeded value.
Freshness gating: a stale prior healthy assessment yields 'stale', never 'healthy' — there is no healthy state without a fresh runtime health_assessment.
The metric is a VECTOR with per-dimension provenance and freshness (forbidOpaqueAggregate); a single red/green scalar is an explicitly rejected alternative.
Maintenance is a first-class set of reversible repair affordances keyed to failing health states — it IS the feedback path (REPAIRED_BY) that re-enters implementation and closes the loop.
rejected: a one-way build->receipt chain that never invalidates itself (mutating any claim must re-open the seal so the gate can no longer fire until re-sealed)
an implementation self-reporting its own health without an independent observer
an unproven observer (one not itself VERIFIED_BY observer_validation yields only a WEAK proof)
one opaque overall health scalar that hides a per-dimension defect
pre-seeding or inferring runtime moments instead of PRODUCING them
incoming: Preconditions DEPENDS_ON justification (feedback; the gate/evidence diamond)

content.role: observer_validation — the check on the checker
content.loop_part: proves the observer detects real faults and never converts missing proof into success; observability_algorithm is VERIFIED_BY / VALIDATED_BY it
tests: detect a broken-but-visible edge the implementation reported as fine
detect a missing proof presented as success
detect stale evidence reused as fresh
detect a renderer 'success' flag that never committed (rendered != committed)
detect the implementation self-reporting health the observer never measured
never convert missing proof into an overall pass
content.consequence: An observer that is not itself proven yields only a WEAK proof; the checker must be checked.

content.loop_part: the INDEPENDENT observer of the loop
content.independence: Reads implementation by fresh readback and re-observes the committed Moment as fresh evidence; does NOT trust the implementation's health claim, the renderer's success flag, the process running-state, or file presence.
checks: implementation is realized as code claims (REALIZED_BY holds)
the committed Moment independently reads back (not self-report)
the metric it PRODUCES is a vector with per-dimension provenance and freshness
no missing proof is converted into success
incoming: Moment independently re-observed as fresh evidence -> observability_algorithm
